LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_SubDays: About {THERE} days there, a while at the town for the answer, and as long back: {ROAD} days in all.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_WontEat: {PAWN} won't eat this on the road
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_LineTip: What is to hand counts the stores and what the rider and the beast carry already. They gather it before they set out; what is left when they come home goes back into the stores.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_RemoveTip: Take it off: the suggestions make up its share from other things and leave this off.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_PutBackTip: Back on, as the suggestions work it out.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Recommended_Tip: Back to the suggestions: food for there and back with some to spare, a little medicine and the beast's feed, by what the stores hold now. Your own numbers and lines are let go.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Gone: The letter or the rider is no longer free to go: nothing was sent.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Button_Tip: Choose what they take for the road: food for there and back, a little medicine, feed for the beast, and anything else from the stores.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Summary: Food for {FOOD} days; the road there and back is {ROAD} days.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_SummaryNoFood: The road there and back is {ROAD} days.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_SummaryFeed: Feed for {FEED} of the {NEED} days {MOUNT} can't graze.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Food_Enough: Food for about {FOOD} days: the road there and back is {ROAD} days, with some to spare.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Food_NoMargin: Food for about {FOOD} days against the {ROAD} days there and back: enough, with nothing to spare.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Food_Short: Food for only about {FOOD} of the {ROAD} days there and back: about {MEALS} meals short.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Food_None: No food packed for the {ROAD} days there and back.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_StoresShort: The stores hold no more that {PAWN} would eat on the road.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Feed_Graze: {MOUNT} grazes all the way: no feed needed.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Feed_Enough: Feed for about {FEED} days against the {NEED} days {MOUNT} can't graze, with some to spare.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Feed_NoMargin: Feed for about {FEED} days against the {NEED} days {MOUNT} can't graze: nothing to spare.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Feed_Short: Feed for only about {FEED} of the {NEED} days {MOUNT} can't graze.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Feed_None: No feed packed for the {NEED} days {MOUNT} can't graze.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Medicine: Medicine: {COUNT}, for a wound or a sickness on the road.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Load: Load: {LOAD} of the {ROOM} kg {PAWN} can carry.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_LoadBeast: Load: {LOAD} of the {ROOM} kg {PAWN} and {MOUNT} can carry.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_GoesShort: {PAWN} goes short, knowing it: the food runs out after about {FOOD} days, and then hunger on the road.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Knowingly: Let them go short, knowing it
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Knowingly_Tip: They set out with what there is. When it runs out they go hungry on the road, as any caravan does: hunger, then malnutrition, slower and in a worse mood the longer it lasts.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Why_Over: More than they can carry ({LOAD} of {ROOM} kg): a caravan that heavy can't move. Take something off.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Why_Stores: The stores can't feed {PAWN} for the road: food for about {FOOD} of the {ROAD} days there and back. Let them go short knowingly, or wait until there is more.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Why_Short: The supplies feed {PAWN} for only about {FOOD} of the {ROAD} days there and back: pack more, or let them go short knowingly.
LanguageData.CC_RiderPack_Why_Feed: {MOUNT} would go hungry: feed for about {FEED} of the {NEED} days it can't graze. Pack more, or let them go short knowingly.
